items.title: What Does Keysight Technologies (KEYS) New 6G UAV Lab Push Mean?
items.summary: Keysight Technologies (NYSE: KEYS) and Cohere Technologies announced a collaboration to bring multi-UAV 6G sensing capabilities into lab environments. The partnership focuses on integrated sensing and communications emulation for fleets of unmanned aerial vehicles in controlled test setups. Researchers can use the joint platform to validate advanced 6G waveforms and multi-UAV scenarios before moving to field trials.
